title: Image allowlist
description: Format of registry/image-allowlist.json (CF20, CF21; docs/images-and-ownership.md). The allowlist is BUNDLED: each client embeds registry/image-allowlist.json from its pinned sprut-contracts submodule at build time. It is never fetched, replaced or extended at runtime, from configuration, from a task manifest or from the coordinator; a signed updatable allowlist is a later stage and needs its own contract. Readers parse the document with the hashing restrictions of docs/canonical-json.md (strict UTF-8, integers only, no duplicate keys) and check kind = image_allowlist; unknown members are rejected. An empty `entries` array is valid and means that every pull and run is refused with IMAGE_NOT_ALLOWED (fail closed). Each digest appears at most once. The guard input `allowlist` is the list of ImageReferences `<repository>@<digest>` of the entries that apply to the running client, in document order; the guard compares whole references, i.e. (repository, digest) pairs. An entry applies when min_client_version <= client version <= max_client_version (when present). The client version is the shared Sprut client release version: Sprut Desktop and the sprut CLI use one version line. Comparison is numeric on MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH; a client pre-release (`0.3.0-rc.1`) is lower than the release with the same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, and pre-release identifiers are not compared further. Removing an entry from the bundled list revokes the image for every client built from it.

purpose.description: diagnostic: smoke-test / doctor container; worker: training and task worker; inference: local generation backend.

platform.description: Container platform of the image. Only linux/amd64 is supported (spec 2).

min_client_version.description: Lowest client version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, no pre-release) that may use this image. An older client treats the entry as absent.

max_client_version.description: Optional highest client version (inclusive, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) that may use this image; a newer client treats the entry as absent.

image_digest.description: ImageDigest: content digest of an image manifest, `sha256:` plus 64 lowercase hex digits. Compared as a string.

repository.description: Fully qualified repository: a registry host with at least one dot (lowercase, no port), then one or more lowercase path components separated by `/`; components use `.`, `_`, `-` only between alphanumerics. At most 255 characters.
